description.value:
Some fighters lead a squad; others forge their bond with a single trusted partner. This variant of the Fireteam Specialist channels the same tactical instincts into a tight, unbreakable partnership with one companion, training and fighting as though they were two halves of a single warrior.

Where the standard Fireteam Specialist rallies a crowd, this one perfects a duet: shared reflexes, shared endurance, and a battlefield understanding so deep that harm to one partner is answered instantly by the other. Together, the pair becomes far more dangerous than either could ever be alone.
